images.alt: Color photograph of a two-story red-brick corner building with an “Ideal Hotel” sign and a Sheridan Radio & Supply Co. sign over the storefront; a street lamp stands at the corner.
Sepia photograph of the two-story brick building with a “Sheridan Radio & Supply Co.” sign across its front, low buildings beside it on an empty street.
Color photograph of the brick building’s long side along the street, with an “Ideal Hotel” sign, shop awnings, and parked cars beyond.
Black-and-white photograph of the brick building with “Sheridan Radio & Supply Co.” across its front and an “Ideal Hotel” sign at the corner; a man stands on the sidewalk.
Black-and-white photograph of the brick corner building with its “Ideal Hotel” sign and a flag at the corner, a street lamp beside it.

curator_note: Five photographs of the Ideal Hotel's building, "Various sources" as the post says, at the size the post shows them.
